static int vs_network_random_ap_password(char *password, size_t size)
{
  static const char alphabet[] =
    "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz23456789";
  const size_t alphabet_len = sizeof(alphabet) - 1;
  uint8_t byte;
  size_t index = 0;
  int fd;
  ssize_t n;

  if (password == NULL || size < 9)
    return -EINVAL;

  fd = open("/dev/urandom", O_RDONLY);
  if (fd < 0)
    return -errno;

  while (index < 8)
    {
      n = read(fd, &byte, sizeof(byte));
      if (n != (ssize_t)sizeof(byte))
        {
          int ret = n < 0 ? -errno : -EIO;
          close(fd);
          return ret;
        }

      /* Reject the incomplete final bucket to avoid modulo bias. */
      if (byte >= (uint8_t)(256u - (256u % alphabet_len)))
        continue;

      password[index++] = alphabet[byte % alphabet_len];
    }

  password[8] = '\0';
  close(fd);
  return 0;
}

  pending = network->provision_event;
  status = network->provision_status;
  network->provision_event = false;
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&network->event_lock);

  if (!pending)
    return -ENOENT;

  if (status < 0)
    return ignore_failure ? -ENOENT : status;

  ret = vs_config_load_wifi(&config);

static int vs_network_apply_sta(struct vs_network_s *network)
{
  struct wpa_wconfig_s wifi;
  struct in_addr cleared;
  unsigned int attempt;
  unsigned int polls;
  uint8_t flags;
  int ret;

  if (network->config.sta_ssid[0] == '\0')
    return vs_network_failed(network, "STA配置", -EBADMSG);

  ret = wapi_set_ifdown(network->sock, "wlan0");
  if (ret < 0 && ret != -ENODEV && ret != -ETIMEDOUT)
    return vs_network_failed(network, "STA关闭接口", ret);
  if (ret == -ETIMEDOUT)
    printf("velasight: STA ifdown timed out; continuing interface reset\n");

  ret = wapi_set_ifup(network->sock, "wlan0");
  if (ret < 0)
     return vs_network_failed(network, "STA开启接口", ret);

  /* SoftAP assigns 192.168.10.1 directly.  Clear its L3 state before DHCP so
   * the client starts in INIT rather than trying to renew the AP address. */

  cleared.s_addr = INADDR_ANY;
  ret = netlib_set_ipv4addr("wlan0", &cleared);
  if (ret < 0)
    return vs_network_failed(network, "STA清除地址", ret);

  ret = netlib_set_ipv4netmask("wlan0", &cleared);
  if (ret < 0)
    return vs_network_failed(network, "STA清除掩码", ret);

  ret = netlib_set_dripv4addr("wlan0", &cleared);
  if (ret < 0)
    return vs_network_failed(network, "STA清除网关", ret);

  memset(&wifi, 0, sizeof(wifi));
  wifi.ifname = "wlan0";
  wifi.sta_mode = WAPI_MODE_MANAGED;
  if (!network->config.sta_open_network &&
      network->config.sta_password[0] != '\0')
    {
      wifi.auth_wpa = IW_AUTH_WPA_VERSION_WPA2;
      wifi.cipher_mode = IW_AUTH_CIPHER_CCMP;
      wifi.alg = WPA_ALG_CCMP;
    }
  wifi.ssid = network->config.sta_ssid;
  wifi.ssidlen = strlen(wifi.ssid);
  wifi.passphrase = network->config.sta_password;
  wifi.phraselen = strlen(wifi.passphrase);

  ret = wpa_driver_wext_associate(&wifi);
  if (ret < 0)
     return vs_network_failed(network, "STA连接", ret);

  polls = VS_ASSOCIATE_TIMEOUT_MS / VS_ASSOCIATE_POLL_MS;
  for (attempt = 0; attempt < polls; attempt++)
    {
      flags = 0;
      ret = netlib_getifstatus("wlan0", &flags);
      if (ret == 0 && (flags & IFF_RUNNING) != 0)
        break;

      usleep(VS_ASSOCIATE_POLL_MS * 1000);
    }

  if (attempt == polls)
    return vs_network_failed(network, "STA关联超时", -ETIMEDOUT);

  ret = -ETIMEDOUT;
  for (attempt = 0; attempt < VS_DHCP_TRIES; attempt++)
    {
      ret = netlib_obtain_ipv4addr("wlan0");
      if (ret == 0)
        {
          break;
        }

      if (attempt + 1 < VS_DHCP_TRIES)
        {
          printf("velasight: STA DHCP attempt %u failed: %d, retrying\n",
                 attempt + 1, ret);
          usleep(VS_DHCP_RETRY_MS * 1000);
        }
    }

  if (ret < 0)
     return vs_network_failed(network, "STA获取地址", ret);

  network->mode = VS_NET_STA;
  network->status.mode = VS_NET_STA;
  network->status.state = VS_NET_STA_READY;
  snprintf(network->status.ssid, sizeof(network->status.ssid), "%s",
           network->config.sta_ssid);
  network->status.password[0] = '\0';
  snprintf(network->status.address, sizeof(network->status.address),
           "STA READY");
  return 0;
}

int vs_network_open(struct vs_network_s **network)
{
  struct vs_network_s *n;
  int ret;

  if (network == NULL)
    return -EINVAL;

  n = calloc(1, sizeof(*n));
  if (n == NULL)
    return -ENOMEM;

  ret = pthread_mutex_init(&n->event_lock, NULL);
  if (ret != 0)
    {
      free(n);
      return -ret;
    }

  n->sock = wapi_make_socket();
  if (n->sock < 0)
    {
      ret = n->sock;
      pthread_mutex_destroy(&n->event_lock);
      free(n);
      return ret;
    }

  ret = vs_config_load_wifi(&n->config);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      close(n->sock);
      pthread_mutex_destroy(&n->event_lock);
      free(n);
      return ret;
    }

  n->mode = VS_NET_STA;
  n->status.mode = VS_NET_STA;
  n->status.state = VS_NET_DOWN;
  *network = n;
  return 0;
}

int vs_network_request_mode(struct vs_network_s *network,
                            enum vs_net_mode_e mode)
{
  int ret;

  if (network == NULL)
    return -EINVAL;

  network->status.error = 0;
  network->status.error_reason[0] = '\0';
  network->status.state = VS_NET_SWITCHING;

  if (network->mode == VS_NET_AP && mode == VS_NET_STA)
    {
      ret = vs_network_stop_provisioning(network);
      if (ret < 0)
        {
          snprintf(network->status.error_reason,
                   sizeof(network->status.error_reason),
                   "AP provisioning stop (%d)", ret);
          network->status.state = VS_NET_ERROR;
          network->status.error = ret;
          return ret;
        }

      /* stop() joins the listener, so no callback can race with this consume.
       * Apply a completed save even when manual exit won the UI race; discard
       * a failed save because the user explicitly chose to leave AP.
       */
      ret = vs_network_consume_saved(network, true);
      if (ret < 0 && ret != -ENOENT)
        {
          snprintf(network->status.error_reason,
                   sizeof(network->status.error_reason),
                   "保存WiFi配置 (%d)", ret);
          network->status.state = VS_NET_ERROR;
          network->status.error = ret;
          return ret;
        }
    }

  ret = vs_network_stop_dhcp(network);
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      snprintf(network->status.error_reason,
               sizeof(network->status.error_reason), "DHCP停止 (%d)", ret);
      network->status.state = VS_NET_ERROR;
      network->status.error = ret;
      return ret;
    }

  /* AP resources are gone before STA association begins.  If association or
   * DHCP then fails, the next network toggle must be able to enter AP again.
   */
  if (mode == VS_NET_STA)
    {
      network->mode = VS_NET_STA;
      network->status.mode = VS_NET_STA;
    }

  ret = mode == VS_NET_AP ? vs_network_apply_ap(network) :
                             vs_network_apply_sta(network);
    if (ret < 0)
      {
        if (network->status.error_reason[0] == '\0')
          snprintf(network->status.error_reason,
                   sizeof(network->status.error_reason),
                   "网络切换 (%d)", ret);
        network->status.state = VS_NET_ERROR;
      network->status.error = ret;
    }

  return ret;
}

int vs_network_process_events(struct vs_network_s *network)
{
  int ret;

  if (network == NULL)
    return 0;

  ret = vs_network_consume_saved(network, false);
  if (ret == -ENOENT)
    return 0;

  if (ret < 0)
    {
      network->status.error = ret;
      network->status.state = VS_NET_AP_READY;
      return ret;

   * credentials are applied only when the user explicitly exits AP mode. */
  return 0;

分析完成，没有改动任何文件。

## 结论

显示初始化本身不慢，只占 1.6 秒。到主屏幕的 22.5 秒里有 20.9 秒是**网络**，而且根因不是"网络慢"，是**主屏幕被网络结果门控了**——UI 线程没被阻塞，但页面停在 `VS_PAGE_PREPARING`（"正在准备"），只有网络 worker 出结果才切走。

## 时间线拆解

| 区间 | 耗时 | 内容 |
|---|---|---|
| 24.366 → 25.363 | ~1.0s | CP 侧：flash ENV、PSRAM、RF 校准，之后 mailbox link ready |
| 25.363 → 25.438 | 75ms | AP 板级 bring-up（psram 堆、按键、PWM、ramdisk、trng） |
| 25.440 → 25.757 | ~317ms | 双 GC9D01 复位 + 50 条初始化表 |
| 25.760 → 25.971 | ~210ms | fb 注册、黑帧填充、LVGL 首帧、背光打开 |
| **25.98 → 31.142** | **~5.2s** | 网络 worker 卡在 `vs_config_wait_for_store()` 等 SD-NAND 挂载 |
| **31.432 → 46.691** | **~15.3s** | `vs_network_apply_sta()` 关联轮询直到 `-ETIMEDOUT` |
| 46.832 | | 页面切到 `HISTORY_BLANK`，`fb0 update 3` = 主屏幕 |

## 三处根因，按收益排序

**1. 主屏幕依赖网络事件（~20.9s，真正的大头）**

`vs_app.c:1282` 把初始页设为 `VS_PAGE_PREPARING`，而离开这个页面的路径只有 `vs_handle_app_event()` 里的 `VS_APP_EVENT_NETWORK_READY` / `VS_APP_EVENT_NETWORK_FAILED`（`vs_app.c:922`、`vs_app.c:932-950`）。网络在 worker 线程上跑（`vs_start_network_worker`），主循环 25.98 就开始转了，所以这 20.9 秒纯粹是等一个状态位，不是等算力。

值得注意的是：`vs_app.c:1308-1317`，当 worker **创建失败**时，代码直接 `runtime.page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK` 进主页。也就是说"主页不需要网络"这个前提作者已经承认了。同时 `vs_history.c` 不读 SD-NAND、`history_blank` 是静态初值为 true，主页确实没有任何数据依赖。开机固定用 `VS_NET_STA` 起 worker，`READY` 分支里那个 `VS_PAGE_SOFTAP` 在开机路径上取不到，只有用户主动切换才会走。

所以最直接的做法是：起完 worker 就进主页，网络结果回来只更新状态区，不再决定页面。这一项单独就能把 22.5s 压到 ~1.7s。

**2. SD-NAND 串行化（~5.2s）**

`vs_config_load_wifi()` 首次调用会进 `vs_config_wait_for_store()`（`vs_config.c:23`），以 100ms 为间隔轮询挂载状态，上限 **700 次 = 70 秒**。凭据存在 `/mnt/sdnand/prov/vela.cfg`（`velasight_provisioning.h:45`），所以必须等 SD-NAND。

而 SD-NAND 又被 `CONFIG_BK7258_SDIO_AUTOINIT_DELAY_MS` 故意推迟 5000ms（`bk7258-ap/Kconfig:48`，`range 0 60000`）。实际初始化只用了 780ms（30.369→31.147），5000 这个值 Kconfig 帮助文本说是"物理复位实测后确定"的经验值。如果实测能确认更短的 settle 时间，这里直接就是几秒。

顺带一个隐患：`vs_config_wait_for_store()` 超时会一路 `-ETIMEDOUT` 传出 `vs_network_open()` → 发 `NETWORK_FAILED`。也就是说 SD-NAND 一旦挂不上，"正在准备"会停 **70 秒**。这是同一个门控问题的更坏形态。

**3. 关联超时跑满 15s（~15.3s）**

`VS_ASSOCIATE_TIMEOUT_MS 15000`（`vs_network.c:25`），`vs_network.c:242` 展开成 150 次 × 100ms 轮询 `IFF_RUNNING`。

CP 日志说明了为什么会跑满：每轮 `scanu_start_req` → 1.73s 扫描 → `get scan result: empty` → `Setting scan request: 2.000000 sec`，约 3.73s 一轮，15s 内跑了 5 轮。关键是 `recv_cnt=29 upload_cnt=0`——收到 29 个 beacon 但一个都没上报，说明配置的 `ssid=test` 不在周围。第一轮扫描结束时结论就已经确定了，剩下 11 秒是白等。

可以按扫描结果判定失败（扫描完成且不含目标 SSID 就没必要再等），大约 4~8s 即可收敛。单纯下调 `VS_ASSOCIATE_TIMEOUT_MS` 是粗暴版，注意别切到两个扫描周期以下，否则会打断首次正常入网。另外 `test` 这个 SSID 本身可疑，像是 `/mnt/sdnand/prov/vela.cfg` 里的遗留测试记录，值得先确认一下——换成真实存在的 SSID 这条路径本来就会快速成功。

做了第 1 项之后，第 2、3 项就不再影响上屏时间，只影响网络状态多久变准确。这是先做第 1 项的理由。
